Vinod Kanchankoti Business Analyst/Payments SME| SWIFT MT/MX | ISO 20022 | Finastra Global PAYplus (GPP) | Cross-Border Payments Pune, India | +91 9422582528 | vinodkanchankoti7@gmail.com |

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Dynamic and results-oriented professional with 8 years of experience in banking and payments domain. Specialized in SWIFT payments, High Value Payments, ISO 20022 messaging, and Global PayPlus (GPP) platform.

Strong expertise in end-to-end payment processing, requirement gathering and management, Identifying Gap, Setup changes and providing solution, stakeholder management and production support. Proven track record of delivering complex payment transformation initiatives, improving STP rates, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Worked on preparation of user story in JIRA, FRSD, and Configuration Requirement document. Experience in Test Management using JIRA and ZYPHER. Worked on release delivery from various code branches with preparation of release notes. Good knowledge of SDLC models, STLC process, Agile (Followed Scrum Method).

CORE SKILLS

• • CBPR+ • High Value Payments Processing • Global PayPlus (GPP Classic & GPP SP) • • Payments & FX Automation • Payment Lifecycle (E2E Processing) • Requirement Gathering & Functional Analysis • • • Defect Management & RCA • • • AI – Friday.AI, Stylus, ChatGPT Stakeholder Management SIT / UAT / Regression Testing

SWIFT Payments (MT / MX) ISO 20022 Messaging

SEPA (SCT & SDD)

SQL, Core Java Tools: JIRA, SoapUI, IntelliJ, Jenkins, FileZilla, Putty, WinSCP, PSD, Qualitia, Zypher

EMPLOYMENT

CitiCorp India Services Pvt. Ltd. Business analyst

Mar 2023 – Present

Project: FX Automation

Core objective is to enhance the CITIFT application for Foreign Exchange (FX) automation • Key functional areas include passive FX flow handling, value date management, FX cut-off processing and dedicated FX repair queues Involved in functional requirement analysis and solution design for FX automation in payment systems



Created FRD, epics, and user stories for payment and FX change requests • • • Performed payment trace analysis, RCA, and defect triaging • Collaborated with Product, Technology, partner systems and Operations teams for solution delivery • • • Created static data set up based on the Requirement Supported UAT and production readiness activities Supported internal automation team with functional and configuration expertise

Implemented automated FX rate sourcing and validation for cross-border and high-value payments Improved Straight Through Processing (STP) and reduced manual intervention

Project: CIPS MT191 Implementation







This project enhances the CITIFT system to efficiently handle incoming MT191 charge message from China’s CIPS system It focuses on ensuring accurate receipt, parsing and mapping of MT191 transaction fields, followed by matching them with original MT100/103 payments Functional Analysis of requirement from Ops & Product Team, Providing walk through for implemented solution to stakeholders

Provided Analysis for the defect raised into scrum Board and logs analysis if defect require any set up fix and Functional assistant to developers for any defect fix

Created User stories for the CITIFT changes. • • Provided High level walk-through to the stake-holders for the changes before implementation and before Go live Led end-to-end implementation of MT191 charge message processing Enabled MT191 to MT202 conversion with accounting and compliance checks Ensured OFAC/sanction screening compliance

• • • Handled duplicate and unmatched transaction scenarios • Delivered project with zero escalation

Finastra / Xoriant Test Engineer

Mar 2020 – Feb 2023

Project: Leading Bank in European Region

Worked on SWIFT High Value Payments and ISO 20022 processing using GPP SP • Performed requirement analysis, test design, and execution • Worked on SEPA Direct Debit and Credit Transfer • Automated API testing using SoapUI • Managed defect lifecycle and release validation Supported STP payment processing systems • • Review CRDs and ensure traceability of all functionalities to be covered by prepared Traceability matrix. • Handled client defects through trace analysis and optimal solutioning Led GUI and functional testing for payment processing modules • Support SMEs, business analysts, and developers with testing-related activities. • • Product: GPP SP 4.6.15 and 4.6.17

Project: Leading Bank in APAC Region

Worked on GPP Classic payment processing platform • Handled incoming and outgoing SWIFT payments • Performed functional testing, defect triaging, and stakeholder discussions





Triage bank defects, analyse test results by examining traces, and supported developers and business analysts. Retested defects and provided solutions to the bank, including setup documentation Supported release cycles and production validation

Bajaj Finserv (Teamlease) Test Engineer

Jun 2018 – Mar 2020

Project: Functional testing of Loan (Gold loan and Commercial Lending) management system

Performed functional and regression testing for Loan Management Systems • Covered Gold Loan and Commercial Lending modules in Pennant application • • Prepared and executed test cases and defect lifecycle management • Coordinated with third-party vendors during UAT • Was stationed at development site center at Hyderabad

Executed testing for EMI, foreclosure, penalties (LPP), accounting flows, charges (AMC)

EDUCATION

B.E. Electronics & Telecommunication — Shivaji University • C-DAC — Sunbeam Institute of Technology

CERTIFICATIONS

Finastra Certified Associate (FCA) • • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) SWIFT Messaging (MT & ISO 20022) • • Advanced Guide – ISO 20022 SWIFT MX Messages

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Citi Gratitude Gold Award – FX Automation Delivery • Citi Gratitude Silver Award – CIPS MT191 Implementation • Delivered multiple Global PAYplus payment implementations for international banks

sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Dynamic and results-oriented professional with 8 years of experience in banking and payments domain. Specialized in SWIFT payments, High Value Payments, ISO 20022 messaging, and Global PayPlus (GPP) platform.
Strong expertise in end-to-end payment processing, requirement gathering and management, Identifying Gap, Setup changes and providing solution, stakeholder management and production support. Proven track record of delivering complex payment transformation initiatives, improving STP rates, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Worked on preparation of user story in JIRA, FRSD, and Configuration Requirement document. Experience in Test Management using JIRA and ZYPHER. Worked on release delivery from various code branches with preparation of release notes. Good knowledge of SDLC models, STLC process, Agile (Followed Scrum Method).

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
EMPLOYMENT
CitiCorp India Services Pvt. Ltd. Business analyst
Mar 2023 – Present
Project: FX Automation
Core objective is to enhance the CITIFT application for Foreign Exchange (FX) automation • Key functional areas include passive FX flow handling, value date management, FX cut-off processing and dedicated FX repair queues Involved in functional requirement analysis and solution design for FX automation in payment systems

Created FRD, epics, and user stories for payment and FX change requests • • • Performed payment trace analysis, RCA, and defect triaging • Collaborated with Product, Technology, partner systems and Operations teams for solution delivery • • • Created static data set up based on the Requirement Supported UAT and production readiness activities Supported internal automation team with functional and configuration expertise
Implemented automated FX rate sourcing and validation for cross-border and high-value payments Improved Straight Through Processing (STP) and reduced manual intervention
Project: CIPS MT191 Implementation



This project enhances the CITIFT system to efficiently handle incoming MT191 charge message from China’s CIPS system It focuses on ensuring accurate receipt, parsing and mapping of MT191 transaction fields, followed by matching them with original MT100/103 payments Functional Analysis of requirement from Ops & Product Team, Providing walk through for implemented solution to stakeholders
Provided Analysis for the defect raised into scrum Board and logs analysis if defect require any set up fix and Functional assistant to developers for any defect fix
Created User stories for the CITIFT changes. • • Provided High level walk-through to the stake-holders for the changes before implementation and before Go live Led end-to-end implementation of MT191 charge message processing Enabled MT191 to MT202 conversion with accounting and compliance checks Ensured OFAC/sanction screening compliance
• • • Handled duplicate and unmatched transaction scenarios • Delivered project with zero escalation
Finastra / Xoriant Test Engineer
Mar 2020 – Feb 2023
Project: Leading Bank in European Region
Worked on SWIFT High Value Payments and ISO 20022 processing using GPP SP • Performed requirement analysis, test design, and execution • Worked on SEPA Direct Debit and Credit Transfer • Automated API testing using SoapUI • Managed defect lifecycle and release validation Supported STP payment processing systems • • Review CRDs and ensure traceability of all functionalities to be covered by prepared Traceability matrix. • Handled client defects through trace analysis and optimal solutioning Led GUI and functional testing for payment processing modules • Support SMEs, business analysts, and developers with testing-related activities. • • Product: GPP SP 4.6.15 and 4.6.17
Project: Leading Bank in APAC Region
Worked on GPP Classic payment processing platform • Handled incoming and outgoing SWIFT payments • Performed functional testing, defect triaging, and stakeholder discussions


Triage bank defects, analyse test results by examining traces, and supported developers and business analysts. Retested defects and provided solutions to the bank, including setup documentation Supported release cycles and production validation
Bajaj Finserv (Teamlease) Test Engineer
Jun 2018 – Mar 2020
Project: Functional testing of Loan (Gold loan and Commercial Lending) management system
Performed functional and regression testing for Loan Management Systems • Covered Gold Loan and Commercial Lending modules in Pennant application • • Prepared and executed test cases and defect lifecycle management • Coordinated with third-party vendors during UAT • Was stationed at development site center at Hyderabad
Executed testing for EMI, foreclosure, penalties (LPP), accounting flows, charges (AMC)
